Strategy: Widen the winning bonus band upward to forty-five while keeping the same penalty, testing whether the extra three units of rewarded leftovers add wins. It may help by covering more good placements, but may fail by diluting the band with looser bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
